explanation: The prize honoured poems he had rendered into English himself, such as Gitanjali. Tagore also wrote the songs that became the national anthems of India and Bangladesh.

claims.text: In 1913 Rabindranath Tagore became the first non-European to win the Nobel Prize in Literature.
Rudyard Kipling won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1907, and Lu Xun and Muhammad Iqbal never won it.
The Nobel citation praised verse that Tagore had expressed in his own English words, as in the English Gitanjali.
Tagore wrote the songs that became the national anthems of India and Bangladesh.
